Hi Emily —

Sorry you hit this. Quick troubleshooting/questions:
- Confirming you followed the activation link in the invite and created/linked a Coupa account, yes?
- Can you paste the exact error (screenshot is helpful) and the email address you see in the Coupa profile (it sometimes normalizes display name vs login).

Laura — looping you in for tenant mapping. My suspicion: the tenant mapping we have uses the company display name "AeroNova Logistics, Inc." in the IdP RelayState, but Emily's Coupa org may be registered under a slightly different casing/punctuation (we've seen hyphens/ampersands and comma differences break the NameID match). If so, we can either reissue the invite with the canonical org slug or do a manual admin activation on our side.

Forwarding the thread to AeroNova IT/support with a couple of suggested checks.

Hi AeroNova support team —

We received an activation error from your user Emily (screenshot attached). Error text: "SAML NameID not found for tenant". Typical root causes we've seen:
- Org display name used in RelayState differs from the tenant name in your IdP (case, punctuation, or extra suffix like "Inc.").
- The user accepted the invite under an account that has a different primary email alias than the one Coupa expects (dots, plus addressing, etc.).
- There's an existing shadow account with the same email in your Coupa tenant.

Practical options:
1) Re-issue the invite using the tenant slug "aeronova-logistics" (avoids punctuation/case differences) — we can do this after you confirm the canonical slug.
2) If you want a faster bypass, our onboarding team can manually link Emily's Coupa account to the AeroNova tenant from the Redwood admin console (we'll need an authorized confirmation from AeroNova IT).

Emily, can you confirm the email shown in your Coupa profile (Settings > Email) and the exact org name you saw in the invite? Ben will coordinate the reissue/manual link.

Attachments: invite-email-eml.txt (headers), screenshot-20270507.png

Best,
Ben Carter
Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: supplies-support@aeronova-logistics.com
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: emily.jensen@aeronova-logistics.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trouble logging into Coupa after accepting invite

Hi Ben / Karthik —

Thanks for the details. We validated on our end: the tenant slug in Coupa for AeroNova is "aeronova-logistics" (no comma, no "Inc."). There was an existing shadow account for emily.jensen@aeronova-logistics.com created by an earlier procurement integration test. That shadow account prevented the NameID match.

We've merged the shadow account into Emily's primary profile and cleared the stale alias. We reissued the invite and asked Emily to clear the browser cache and try the activation link again. Emily confirmed success at 15:01 PT — she can now see the Redwood supplier record and the test PO.

Action taken: merged shadow account; reissued invite (new invite id: INV-20270508-AERO-2); confirmed login.

Thanks for the quick help. Please let us know if you want us to export logs for audit.

Cheers,
AeroNova Vendor Support
